title: Virk advises the Galileo Project and the Sol Project
place_text: Galileo Project; Sol Project at Stanford

tellings.quote: I'm I'm an advisor to the Galileo Project and peripherally involved with the Sol Project as well at Stanford.

plain: In the 2020s, the computer scientist Rizwan Virk, who is linked to MIT, became an advisor to the Galileo Project, a scientific effort that uses telescopes and sensors to look for signs of alien technology. He was also loosely involved with the Sol Project, a Stanford group studying unexplained phenomena. Virk says this about himself, telling Michels "I'm an advisor to the Galileo Project," to show that he works with serious scientific attempts to study the subject.
